name: Sten Stoutarm
summary: Outside Anvilmar, Sten Stoutarm keeps recruits equipped and messages moving through Coldridge Valley. Winter blizzards cut off the valley, and dangers nearby make warmth, food, and clear instructions vital.

sections.title: A Helping Hand in the Snow
sections.body: Near the tavern outside Anvilmar, Sten Stoutarm meets new dwarven and gnomish recruits. Winter blizzards cut off Coldridge Valley, and dangers lie close at hand. So Sten gives green apprentices sturdy gear to face the snow prepared.

sections.title: Keeping the Lines Open
sections.body: Sten gathers wolf hides for winter clothing and carries messages through Coldridge Valley. He takes dispatches through dangerous Coldridge Pass, then brings official runes, memoranda, and orders to class trainers across the basin. Troggs block the tunnels, yet young warriors, priests, and mages still need their instructions.

faq.answer: Outside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Sten Stoutarm outfits recruits and carries messages. He helps new arrivals get warm clothing and local mail delivered.

faq.q: What role does he play in Coldridge Valley?
faq.answer: Sten outfits apprentices and carries messages for Anvilmar. He gathers wolf meat and pelts for protective gear, then routes correspondence and training memoranda across the valley.

faq.q: Why does Sten need mail delivered?
faq.answer: Troggs and winter weather make Coldridge Pass dangerous, hindering mail and supplies bound for the valley. When messages arrive, Sten asks dependable newcomers to deliver parcels and letters to residents such as Talin Keeneye.

faq.q: What does Sten think about the troggs in the valley?
faq.answer: Sten is weary of the troggs in the surrounding hills. He says that once you have seen one trogg, you have seen them all.

faq.q: Why does he ask for wolf meat?
faq.answer: Sten trades warm, durable gloves for tough wolf meat. The meat feeds the valley's defenders, while the gloves protect them from Dun Morogh's cold.

faq.q: What are the runes and memoranda Sten gives to new adventurers?
faq.answer: The runes and memoranda are sealed letters and training tokens sent by superiors across Ironforge and Dun Morogh. They direct young apprentices to report to their class trainers inside Anvilmar.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can count on Sten's practical hospitality in Dun Morogh. He gives you thick leather and food before you head into the snow.
As a gnomish refugee training alongside dwarves in Anvilmar, you face Sten's practical expectations too. He sends you with mail and gear for the elements.
As an Alliance member, you depend on messages through Coldridge Pass to keep Ironforge's training grounds connected. Sten carries mail across the valley.
